name: dataroot
description: Dataroot integration via the Dataroot REST API — discover the organizations you belong to, their connections and data sources, inspect a data source's schema/table/column metadata, list organization members, and check the signed-in account and quota. Authenticates with your Dataroot email and password to mint a short-lived access token per invocation; secret data-source settings (passwords, access keys, credentials) are masked before output. Dataroot is a Buildersoft LLC product.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Dataroot organization, connection, and data-source discovery and metadata

fields.label: Base URL
fields.helpText: Your Dataroot API base URL, e.g. https://api.dev.dataroot.at (no trailing slash).

fields.label: Email Address
fields.helpText: The email address of the Dataroot account used for API access.

fields.label: Password
fields.helpText: The account password. Used only to obtain a short-lived access token per call — it is never stored by the skill.

tools.name: dataroot.list_organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the authenticated account belongs to (id and name). Use this to discover which organizations you can query.

tools.name: dataroot.list_connections
tools.description: List the connections in an organization, with each connection's status and data-source count.

tools.name: dataroot.list_data_sources
tools.description: List the data sources in an organization. Aggregates across the organization's connections (capped) when connectionId is omitted, or scopes to a single connection when it is given. Returns id, name, type, category, status, tags, and owning connection — no connection settings/secrets.

connectionId.description: Optional connection id to scope the listing to a single connection

tools.name: dataroot.get_data_source
tools.description: Get one data source's details and settings by connection and source id. Secret settings values (passwords, access keys, credentials) are masked.

connectionId.description: The connection id the data source belongs to

tools.name: dataroot.get_data_source_metadata
tools.description: Get a data source's schema/table/column metadata (schemas, tables, and columns with their types), summarized and capped to stay compact.

dataSourceId.description: The data source id whose metadata to fetch

tools.name: dataroot.list_members
tools.description: List the members of an organization (name, email, owner flag, and membership status).

tools.name: dataroot.whoami
tools.description: Return the authenticated account's profile (and monthly quota when available). Useful as a connectivity/identity check.
